mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password_hash AS passwordHash, role, active, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} AND active = 1
SELECT id, username, password_hash AS passwordHash, role, active, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM sys_user ORDER BY id
SELECT id, username, password_hash AS passwordHash, role, active, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (username, password_hash, role, active) VALUES (#{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{role}, #{active})
